script_text: Your emotional tide is about to shift dramatically, water-sign Cancer. Early this week, Sun opposes Pluto in your 10th House, exposing career pressures and power struggles at work. On Tuesday, Venus trines Jupiter in your 3rd House, sparking flirtatious messages and a romantic reconnection. Wednesday is the turning point — the New Moon in your 9th House launches fresh momentum and a sudden opportunity to expand your horizons. Thursday through Saturday, Mercury squares Saturn in your 10th House, testing your communication at work — delays and criticism may sting. Sunday soothes you as Venus sextiles Uranus in your 4th House, bringing an unexpected windfall or financial gift from family. Sunday is the best day for love and money. Wednesday is the worst for career conflicts. Protect your boundaries fiercely this week. Follow for daily updates.
